_about: Phase 1 item 4 — in-prose cross-links between the concern (solution) pages and the ingredient research hubs, which were two closed loops with zero links between them. Each entry appends one sentence to an EXISTING rich-text setting in a standard theme section; no new sections, no custom code. Anchors vary deliberately (anchor variety was the strongest effect in the Zyppy internal-link study). English source only: the other locales keep their current text until the German pass, which is harmless because nothing is being removed. Applied by scripts/add-prose-links.py.
